findings.headline: 192.168.1.23 changed L2 owner 70x across 560 captures, between 2 MACs
cannot_prove: which switch port each MAC sits behind -- needs the switch MAC table
whether one claimant is a legitimate second interface of the same host
findings.next_probe: diagnose switch mac-address list | grep -E '50:9a:4c:87:29:b3|d4:43:0e:1a:c5:88'

verification.note: address has settled on d4:43:0e:1a:c5:88, which holds no lease -- the lease holder 50:9a:4c:87:29:b3 has lost it entirely across 12 recent captures
verification.note_zh: 地址已稳定落到无租约的 d4:43:0e:1a:c5:88 手上 —— 最近 12 次采集里,租约持有者 50:9a:4c:87:29:b3 完全失去了这个地址

verify.what: watch which MAC currently owns the address
verify.what_zh: 查看该地址当前由哪个 MAC 持有

verify.what: differential port probe: the two claimants expose different services, so the open-port set changes with the ARP owner
verify.what_zh: 差分端口探测:两个占用方开放的服务不同,开放端口集合会随 ARP 归属一起变化
verify.command: for i in $(seq 30); do printf '%s ' "$(ip neigh show 192.168.1.23 | grep -o 'lladdr .*' | cut -d' ' -f2)"; nc -z -w1 192.168.1.23 22 && printf '22:open ' || printf '22:shut '; sleep 1; echo; done

verify.what: confirm the second claimant holds no lease
verify.what_zh: 确认第二个占用方没有租约

fix.what: find the switch port behind each MAC
fix.what_zh: 定位每个 MAC 背后的交换机端口
fix.command: diagnose switch mac-address list

fix.what: move the unmanaged device to a free, reserved address
fix.what_zh: 把无台账的设备迁到一个空闲且已保留的地址
fix.command: # on the device's own console

fix.what: reserve the address for the legitimate MAC so DHCP cannot reissue it
fix.what_zh: 为合法 MAC 保留该地址,防止 DHCP 再次下发
fix.command: config system dhcp server / edit <id> / config reserved-address

fix.what: clear the stale binding and re-check
fix.what_zh: 清除过期绑定后复查
fix.command: ip neigh flush dev <iface> && ip neigh show 192.168.1.23

verify.what: list current admin accounts and their source restrictions

verify.what: re-read the login audit for successes, not just failures
